title: Smiling Woman Kneeling with Bags on Wooden Pier, 1940s Wharf Snapshot Photo
description: A cheerful woman kneels on the wide planking of an ocean pier or wharf beside her travel bags and luggage. She wears a striped short-sleeved mid-century summer day dress. Narrow-gauge rail tracks run along the wooden deck behind her, where various pedestrians and travelers in light summer clothing stroll under the bright coastal sky.
